data.title: Deutschlandticket subscription confirmation
data.summary: Musterstadt Verkehrsbetriebe GmbH (MVB) confirms your order of a Deutschlandticket subscription as a mobile ticket, valid from 1 January 2026 for €63.00 per month. It runs indefinitely and can be cancelled monthly.
data.explanation: This confirms your Deutschlandticket subscription (personal, non-transferable, 2nd class, valid nationwide on local transport). €63.00 is debited by SEPA direct debit at the start of each month. The subscription has no fixed end. To end it at the end of a month, your cancellation must reach MVB by the 10th of that month, online, by email or in writing. If the price changes, MVB will tell you at least six weeks ahead, and you may then cancel as of the date the change takes effect. No action is needed now.
